sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The Hunter Transmission Project (HTP) is being developed as Critical State Significant Infrastructure (CSSI) and a Priority Network Infrastructure Project (PNIP) under the Electricity Infrastructure Investment Act 2020 (EII Act).

The project consists of a new 500 kilovolt (kV) double-circuit transmission line between Bayswater and Olney, to complete the northern part of the Sydney Ring and provide the backbone of the State’s electricity grid. As remaining coal-fired power stations close, HTP is critical for energy security in New South Wales (NSW). Under the Roadmap and the EII Act, EnergyCo has several key functions as Infrastructure Planner (IP), including:

- To make and enter contracts or other agreements in connection with the exercise of its functions under the EII Act.
- To investigate, plan, co-ordinate and carry out planning, design, construction and operation of storage and network infrastructure.

The procurement aims to supplement EnergyCo's internal capability with experienced resources and specialist expertise to support effective project delivery. The services will assist EnergyCo in managing technical matters, providing specialist technical advice, supporting construction activities and interfaces, and responding to evolving project requirements.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The tender is aimed to be released by early September 2026.

The scope includes:

- Package A: Technical personnel to support the HTP team in the management, coordination and delivery of technical activities
- Package B: Technical advisory services with expertise across a range of technical disciplines.
- Package C: Construction interface personnel to support planning and coordination of site activities with key stakeholders and interfaces during the delivery of HTP.

Further details regarding the scope, requirements and procurement process will be provided when the tender is released.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Please note that one of the mandatory requirements is:

Supplier must have full prequalification on SCM0005 – Performance and Management Services Scheme (Engagement Type 15 Infrastructure services- Major Project Procurement/ Delivery and Project Management); or certified prequalification on SCM1191 - Consultants in Construction up to $9 Million Scheme (work category – Management).

The tender ID of this future opportunity will be SR01373.
